messages:
mira_cs: Heads-up — OpalEdge Dedicated bring-up tomorrow AM. They want a fast ramp and a smoke + full circuit load test. Can we confirm quotas and autoscale hooks? :eyes:
ajahn_eng: On quotas: they asked for 12k rps baseline with 18k burst. Need to map that to GPU slots. I think 6xA100 equiv should cover steady, +2 for headroom.
tom_runtime: Re: autoscale, we need their expected tail-latency SLO. If they want 95th < 200ms we'll keep more reserved. Ask OpalEdge for per-route latency targets.
lina_onboard: I already have an enablement deck and runbook draft here: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/opaledge-dedicated — includes warmup checklist, prefix cache priming steps, and key contacts.
mira_cs: Nice. OpalEdge gave this: "target 95th 250ms, average 100ms; 24/7 traffic, weekday peak 2x baseline". Also flagged renewal sensitivity if first month has >3 outages. We should avoid that.
ajahn_eng: Good to know. Proposal: quota config as commit of 6 reserved GPUs, burst pool of 2 on Dedicated, autoscale policy: scale+1 GPU at 70% sustained token throughput for 2m, scale-down after 10m idle. I'll paste config snippet below.
```
autoscale:
  policy: sustained_throughput
  scale_up_threshold: 0.7
  scale_up_window: 120s
  scale_down_window: 600s
  burst_pool: 2
```

tom_runtime: LGTM but add a cooldown and max_scale to avoid noisy oscillation: `max_instances: 10`, `cooldown: 90s`. Also enable fallback routing to smaller model if queue length > 500.
loadbot: load-test-scheduler: scheduled run in 24h; workload profile: ramp 0->12k rps over 12m, hold 30m, spike to 18k for 10m, collect p50/p95/p99 and error rates.
lina_onboard: Can someone own running the KV priming? I can lead the customer-facing session but need a runtime engineer for the priming commands.
ajahn_eng: I can take priming. Quick priming note for team: run a coordinated KV cache fill using their golden prompt set, with batch size 16, seq_len 1024 to simulate realistic token patterns. Example command: 
```
./prime.sh --model opal-13b --batch 16 --seq 1024 --input-file golden_prompts.txt
```

mira_cs: Action items then: (1) AJ to finalize autoscale + quota config and upload to playbooks by EOD. (2) Tom to add cooldown + fallback routing. (3) AJ + Lina to run KV priming during smoke slot (tomorrow 09:15). (4) Loadbot to run full load test 10:00-11:00 and post results. (5) Mira to run renewal risk review with AM after test.
tom_runtime: I'll add the cooldown and fallback policy into the canary config and push. Also will wire alert: `alert_opal_latency_violation` if p95 > 300ms for 5m.
loadbot: test scheduled; I'll post concise results in this thread: p50/p95/p99, errors, GPU utilization, queue depth, and traces sample link.
mira_cs: Customer feedback capture: I'll open a short survey and set a 48h follow-up meeting. Also collecting any rough notes from today's run will help our renewal conversation.
ajahn_eng: One ask for CS: if renewal is sensitive, let's enable extended debug logs for first 72h to help fast triage (logs go to private bucket). Lina, can you share the access steps with OpalEdge?
lina_onboard: Yes — I'll include S3 presigned steps + minimal IAM policy in the runbook.
mira_cs: Great. Anything else?
ajahn_eng: One more: during load test, lock model weights to non-rolling to avoid accidental rollout. Add `rollout: locked` in deploy.
tom_runtime: noted. I'll tag the canary with `no-rollout` during the window.
mira_cs: Perfect. I'll sync with OpalEdge legal on SLA wording after the test. Thanks team :thumbsup:
